stable.notes: The Meeting Turbo preview checkbox was lying. It read your setting as "on only if explicitly set to 1", but an unset value reads as nothing — so the box showed OFF for everyone who had never touched it, while the server had the feature running the whole time. Three more settings that ship on by default in server 6.37.0 — Continue agent threads, Reliable video uploads and Adaptive audio cleanup — had the same mistake in their stopped-server display.
